key_insight: The paper learns Koopman embeddings with a kernel-based autoencoder trained by bilevel optimization, avoiding a fixed hand-designed dictionary.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable, interpretable alternative to neural autoencoders for data-driven nonlinear system modeling and forecasting.
method: Build an EDMD-style Koopman approximation with a learned kernel dictionary.
Use bilevel optimization to jointly fit the embedding and the linear Koopman model.
Leverage collocation to keep kernel matrix size tied to collocation points, not full dataset size.
evidence_signal: Across experiments including sea-surface-temperature forecasting and video learning, EDMD-kDL matched or outperformed ANN-based baselines.
watch_item: Performance and scalability depend on choosing collocation points and kernel design well, so poor hyperparameter choices may limit accuracy.
paper_title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
